verdict.rationale: Sentry documents a public REST API (e.g. issue-listing/mutation endpoints) plus a CLI and SDKs that let programmatic/AI-driven clients interact with the platform, and pricing explicitly lists 'API & third-party integrations' as a tier feature. However, probes for a formal OpenAPI/swagger spec all 404'd, so there's no machine-readable schema confirmed, and independent hands-on corroboration of API usage is absent. Missing for 10: a discoverable OpenAPI/swagger spec, independent developer confirmation of API usage.
